faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Project Technical Support-I (Data Entry Operator) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 24th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year graduate degree with one year of relevant experience, or a 10th pass with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) and two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,000 plus 20% HRA, with a 5% increment at the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-I role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-I (Data Entry Operator) position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.
